prompt:
Write a first-person account (about 120 words) by the driver for an insurance claim form. Accident: rear-end collision in Conroe, Texas. Injury: concussion. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1265; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The claimant later added small details, but the account stayed the same.
- The driver is named on the policy.
text: I was stopped at a red light on a main road in Conroe, Texas, when the vehicle behind me struck the rear of my car. The impact pushed me forward against my seatbelt and my head snapped back against the headrest. I got out and spoke with the other driver, who confirmed that he had been looking at his phone and did not brake in time. Later that day I developed a headache, dizziness, and trouble concentrating, and a doctor diagnosed a concussion. Over the following days I recalled a few more details, such as the color of the other car and where the traffic was backed up, but my core account of how the collision happened has not changed. I am the named driver on this policy, and I am submitting this claim for my medical treatment and vehicle repairs.
